subject: HorizonBank vendor review: vulnerability sampling & SLA for critical CVEs
messages:
From: Horizon Bank Security <security@horizonbank.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 06 Oct 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor request: VM sampling, SLA for critical CVEs

Hi Kimberly,

I'm Alex Sullivan from Horizon Bank's security team. We're updating our vendor evidence pack for an internal audit and need the following items specific to vulnerability management for Redwood's hosted inference service used by our pilot team: 

- A brief statement of your SLA/commitments for remediation of Critical CVEs (including any conditional exceptions).
- A recent scan sampling showing cadence across prod clusters (last 90 days) and a short description of your scanning cadence policy.
- Proof of at least one remediation trace for a Critical or High CVE in the last 6 months (patch manifest or commit log).

We prefer a one-page PDF we can present to auditors plus the raw index CSV for our records. If you need scope clarifications (prod vs internal infra) let us know. Can you provide these by EOD Wednesday (10/08)?

Thanks,
Alex Sullivan
Senior InfoSec Analyst
Horizon Bank
security@horizonbank.com

Attachments requested: (please attach as separate files)
- scan_index.csv (CSV)
- patch_manifest.pdf (PDF)
- remediation_commit_log.csv (CSV)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Horizon Bank Security <security@horizonbank.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 06 Oct 2025 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor request: VM sampling, SLA for critical CVEs

Alex —

Thanks for the heads-up and the clear list. Quick answers up front: 
- Redwood's operating commitment: we commit to an operational SLA of 30 days for "Critical" CVEs when there is public exploit evidence or an active exploit affecting comparable managed services; otherwise our standard target is 45 days from verification to remediation deployment for Criticals. For Highs we aim for 90 days depending on risk and compensating controls.

- Scope: by default we provide evidence for our hosted inference service (production inference clusters and associated control plane services). If you need infra-level scanning for customer-managed private deployments please advise and we'll scope separately.

I'll attach a recent scan index (exported 2025-10-03) and our Q3 patch manifest; those should cover the examples you requested. Monica (cc) will pull the remediation trace CSV and a one-page process summary.

If you need the SLA as an addendum for procurement/audit sign-off we can push a DocuSign addendum — let me know and we'll route through legal. Plan is to get the materials to you by EOD 10/08.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Attachments included: scan_index_20251003.csv (csv), patch_manifest_Q3-2025.pdf (pdf)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Horizon Bank Security <security@horizonbank.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 07 Oct 2025 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor request: VM sampling, SLA for critical CVEs

Alex / Kimberly —

Attached are the remediation artifacts you asked for: a filtered commit log showing the remediation path for CVE-2025-3142 (Critical, discovered 2025-08-12) and a concise one-page "VM process" PDF that covers scan cadence, triage SLAs, ownership, and rollback policy. Short notes: 

- CVE-2025-3142: discovery -> triage (24h) -> patch development (5d) -> canary deploy + verification (3d) -> full rollback-safe deployment (2d). End-to-end remediation visible in the attached CSV.
- Scan cadence: nightly authenticated scans against control plane, weekly full host scans on prod slices, monthly full infra scans; IDS/monitoring complements for runtime detection.

We also published a short statement for auditors (included in the one-pager). If you need the formal SLA added to contract language we can initiate a DocuSign addendum; link below is the draft; legal prefers the addendum for any binding 3rd-party SLA.

Attachments: cve_commit_log_2025Q3.csv (csv), vm-process-onepager.pdf (pdf)
Draft addendum link: https://app.redwood.com/sla-addendum/HRZN-2025-09

--
Marissa Cole
Security Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Horizon Bank Security <security@horizonbank.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 08 Oct 2025 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor request: VM sampling, SLA for critical CVEs

Kim / Marissa —

Thanks, this is exactly what we needed. The one-pager and commit log look good; the CVE example and timeline are helpful. We have two asks to close the packet: 

1) Please initiate the DocuSign SLA addendum so our procurement team can sign (we'll countersign and include with audit artifacts). The draft link in your message looks fine — happy for you to send from Legal.

2) Could you share a direct engineering contact for a short weekly 15-minute sync next week? We'll do a quick handoff to our cloud-security engineer to make sure the audit interpretation is correct.

If you can send the DocuSign by EOD Thursday (10/09) and a contact (name + email + best times), we can close our internal audit note.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Alex Sullivan
Senior InfoSec Analyst
Horizon Bank
security@horizonbank.com
